Readable API-v1 audio .arch packages support search, direct audio URLs and settings stored in Keychain. Enable Modules in the source order to use them. Signed sessions, extension permissions, metadata and lyrics providers, native Android binaries and inline DASH/DRM contracts are unavailable on iOS.

Widgets, CarPlay and playback controls that iOS provides instead of Android background services.

Add Natune controls from the iOS home-screen widget gallery. The small widget toggles playback; the medium widget also skips tracks. Controls open Natune and use your current queue. Current song text needs a signed App Group shared with the app. Listening insights and lock-screen lyrics widgets are not available yet.
CarPlay library and queue browsing require a build provisioned with Apple’s approved audio-app entitlement. Device operation is unverified. AirPlay and iOS Now Playing controls remain available.
Android’s custom always-on display is unavailable on iOS. Lock-screen playback uses iOS Now Playing; custom lyrics displays require a separate ActivityKit integration.

AVAudioEngine supports independent pitch, EQ and preamp, the clarity filter contour and a high-pass approximation of DC removal. Full clarity stereo/exciter processing, the shared limiter/dither chain and silence skipping are unavailable. Track loudness measurement is not wired; unmeasured tracks keep their original level. Optional Audio Units may be bypassed if the output route rejects them.
This setting uses an Android service or output contract unavailable on iOS.
Track loudness measurement is not available in this build. Unmeasured tracks keep their original level.
Start playback to check the accepted USB rate.
Decoder PCM: %1$d Hz. iOS output route: %2$d Hz.

Higher rates are requested only for USB audio. iOS and your DAC choose the accepted rate; a request does not prove source quality or physical DAC output. Changes apply on the next track or playback reload. High-rate tracks use ordinary handoff instead of crossfade. EQ, pitch and system mixing remain available; this is not USB-exclusive or bit-perfect output.
